name: Wearsight
description: Look over what you are wearing and see how much use is left in it.

name: Daily Step
description: Step out of one place and into another you have walked to before on this island. Once a day. The longer the road you skip, the more it takes out of you.

name: Tether
description: Keep a hold on what you drop when you fall, so it stays yours alone a quarter of an hour longer. Cast it beforehand and it waits for your next fall; cast it after, and it holds what is already lying there. One fall at a time.

name: Larder Ward
description: Set a ward over the pens at your farmstead. While it holds, an empty trough is filled from your store and the bedding can wait. The more head you keep, the more it takes.

name: Sending
description: Send one stack from your pack to a store of your own, or fetch one back, from anywhere on the island.

name: Kindle
description: Light the ground where you stand, so the work done here goes further for everyone who comes to do it, for a while. You are rewarded for each of them.

name: Portal
description: Open a doorway between where you stand and any place on this island you have walked to. It stays open a few minutes, and anyone at either end may go through, there or back. The longer the road it skips, the more it takes.
